name: Password Sign-In Flow Integration Proof
summary: Registers integration proof that the real authentication flow entry point, PasswordLoginFlowHandler and LagoVista SignInManager execute canonical success, rejected and locked-out password sign-in paths.
notes: Rejected has two runtime proofs because invalid password and unknown account share one canonical public outcome while retaining distinct internal audit events.
The lockout branch has its own runtime proof and canonical transition.
AptixEvidence and AptixAuthEvents properties allow the test builder to emit machine-readable run evidence under .aptix/evidence.
Scenario ownership is explicit so reconciliation does not infer test coverage from transition overlap.

sourceReferences.note: Canonical integration evidence source for all three Password Sign In outcomes.
Extracts AptixEvidence metadata from the compiled test assembly for runtime evidence generation.
